event_behavior: AuthContext listener schedules establishSession for every SDK auth event and cleans up the subscription on unmount.
unauthenticated: user/session null; profile and role resolution cleared
role_missing: roleResolution.status=ready with empty roles; ProtectedRoute shows waiting/unauthorized state
error: authError or profile/role error state; protected content is not rendered
logout: supabase.auth.signOut through SupabaseAuthRepository, then clear application session state
